response.sql: WITH driver_qualifying_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualifying_records FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) as avg_records FROM driver_qualifying_counts) SELECT dqc.driverId, dqc.qualifying_records, dqc.qualifying_records / aq.avg_records as ratio FROM driver_qualifying_counts dqc CROSS JOIN avg_qualifying aq ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
